summary: Folder rows explain why they are waiting, conflicts stop looping, and the account summary no longer contradicts its status light.
changelog: A folder row that is queued behind the shared synchronization permit now names the folder it is waiting on ('Waiting for <folder> to finish…') instead of a generic wait (issue #165).

A run that ends with conflicted copies no longer re-queues the local feedback, so a folder with unresolved conflicts stops bouncing into a sync loop; it stays in the review-the-log state until the user addresses it (issue #165).
The account summary card no longer reads 'Connected' next to a red status light: the text now matches the severity (error, credentials rejected, keyring locked, delete review, not connected).
Spanish: the deletion-guard wording uses 'borrados masivos' instead of 'eliminaciones'.
